apps.name: TanTimer
apps.subtitle: Reminder to flip for even tanning!
apps.versionDescription: Reminder to flip for even tanning!
apps.localizedDescription: Reminder to flip for even tanning! After the selection of the customised time window just tap one time the big button in the middle of the screen to stop/pause while a long press to reset the countdown to the selecting time frame. If the swich on the bottom is set on system then a simple ring  sound will be played, instead if custom is set then you can select any audio file to be reproduced from your local storage (It can be also a recording using the voice memos native ios app). The  sound selected will be played for 5 sec before the countdown restarts again.

permissions.usageDescription: Allows the app to refresh content in the background
permissions.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow TanTimer to access your microphone for custom alert sounds.

apps.name: TrackRecStudio
apps.subtitle: Multi-tracks recording
apps.localizedDescription: My aim was to create the simplest and a very intuitive multitrack recording studio.

permissions.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app needs microphone access to record audio tracks for your multitrack recordings. Your audio data stays completely private on your device.
permissions.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app may access your photo library to save or share your audio recordings as files.
